trainingPolicy: local-only; production receives compact ensemble members, never the training database

methodology.split: strict exact-subpatch walk-forward; stacking weights and temperatures use past out-of-fold predictions only
methodology.baseline: historical team strength + Radiant learned without target-subpatch outcomes

deployment.gate: Sufficient coverage on every exact version, at least 3 future-patch folds, >60% folds won, aggregate incremental log loss improvement above 0.002, and series-cluster bootstrap upper 95% delta below zero. This gate is versus team-only, not incremental to the active formula.
